body:
Someone keeps almost fitting the banished want into the bigger life.

They accommodate it a little in every expansion plan, a side project here, a carved-out hour there, without ever actually including it.

With Jupiter quincunx Lilith, people plan the growth while holding an appetite the growth keeps scheduling for later.

So they patch each new plan to cover the same omission.

The plans may keep growing, but a want people perpetually schedule for later becomes the reason the growth never satisfies.
